content: A recent study on expert search strategies among healthcare information professionals BIBREF0 showed that, for a given search task, they spend an average of 60 minutes per collection or database, 3 minutes to examine the relevance of each document, and 4 hours of total search time. When written in steps, their search strategy spans over 15 lines and can reach up to 105 lines.
